subject.summary: In this page the buyer corresponds to O*NET13-1022.00 wholesale and retail buyers, except farm products: buying non-agricultural goods for wholesale or retail resale, analyzing sales and inventory, comparing price and quality, selecting suppliers, and negotiating terms.
